giver.description: Whose questline it is: a faction or a character, by id; left out, the world's own.

steps.description: The steps, in order: each opens once the one before is complete and its own requirements hold.

requires.description: What must hold for the character doing the quest, all of it.

done.description: Progress through other quests: quest (finished), quest.stage (reached) or quest.stage.choice (made).

member.description: Factions the character must be in.

not_member.description: Factions the character must not be in.

additionalProperties.description: A rank on the faction's ladder.

rank_at_least.description: At least this rank in each faction, by faction id.

standing.description: Standing with each faction or character, by id.

within_tolerance.description: Factions whose member tolerance the character must be within, as the faction pictures them.

leftovers.description: When need is fewer than all the quests: whether the rest stay open, or close, if not yet started, once the character starts a quest of any later step.

need.description: How many of the quests must be done to move on, at most all of them; left out, all. 0 makes them optional.

quests.description: The step's quests, open together and done in any order. A quest is in at most one questline, at one step.

requires.description: Added to the gate of every quest in the step.

description: Questlines, each a table keyed by its id: an ordered list of steps, each a group of quests done in any order (DESIGN.md §17.1).
title: questlines.toml
